jobs.name: ghstore-reconcile
jobs.prompt:
Run the GitHub-first state reconcile and report the result.

Execute this exact command:

    sh /data/.hermes/ghfirst/reconcile.sh

It pushes any local Hermes state changes to the GitHub repository, then verifies the committed tree's integrity, then prints drift. The credential is read from /data/.hermes/.env automatically — never print, echo, or reveal its contents or any token value.

Reply with a SHORT plain-text status: the commit sha pushed (if any), whether verify passed, the drift counts (local-only / remote-only / differing), and if anything failed, the exact error and the exit code. If nothing changed, say 'no changes — repo in sync'. Keep it to a few lines. Never claim success unless the command's own output said VERIFY OK.
